scope: Read-only source/config/result/unit-record audit; independent Fraction sums and seeded probe replay; no production source or upstream edits.

v1_v2_changes: controllers added for A3-transformed and accepted-count
risk/coverage delta per controller-family changed from 1/120 to 1/240 to retain 1/10 global union budget over 6 scores x 2 controllers x 2 error events
positive-control note and revision reason added

independent_calibration_reconstruction.method: Recomputed HB log-p values, transformed losses or accepted-only losses, Bonferroni threshold factor, and Hoeffding lower coverage bound from C unit rows; no innovation calibration functions used.

selected_population_referee_rebuilt_from.scope_note: Conditional on the realized B-fitted learned score and selected threshold; integrates score-probe noise only, not B/C selection uncertainty.

diagnostics.interpretation: Clipping changes the surrogate; not algorithmic improvement.

P1: Accepted-count validity is conditional on true IID units, fixed score family, B/C/T independence, score/loss probe independence, and bounded unbiased MC loss. Code checks metadata and caller assertions, not truth of assumptions.
Seeded finite simulation and exact finite population diagnostic do not establish external or empirical IID, distribution shift robustness, real-world risk, or superiority.
No matched total-cost comparison or native LIME run; learned histogram is existing fixed-cell mean regression, not LIME.
P2: V2 changes multiplicity allocation and adds a controller relative to unexecuted V1; rationale is multiplicity accounting, while scientific thresholds/sample sizes are unchanged. Artifacts/hash support use of V2, but file artifacts alone cannot independently timestamp pre-outcome chronology.
Accepted-count reference and transformed LTT use different test statistics; positive-control power is not efficacy or novelty evidence.

limitations: Audit author previously implemented H1, so this is not external Agent5 custody.
No private data, production code changes, upstream changes, or new pilot run.
Guarantee review is mathematical/code inspection, not formal proof.
